routing_and_status.known_seam: Reporting layer already has get_attention_record(item_type,item_id) delegating to whole-key source reads (packages/pipelines/reporting_service.py:880-881; packages/domains/overview/pipelines/attention_records.py:97-160). It binds the full opaque key; does not split IDs; can return multiple rows; differentiates not-found from unavailable. It is not exposed in apps/api/routes or generated web OpenAPI at this HEAD (rg found no API call-site).
routing_and_status.prerequisites_from_reviewed_stage_b: Exact REST path/method, kind enum, request/response schema, auth permissions, status codes for 403/404/503, error-body schema, and generated OpenAPI artifact must come from landed/frozen Stage B; do not name/assume an endpoint before that. Need confirmed percent-encoded slash behavior on server and API path. Existing service method may be backing seam but its presence does not establish HTTP contract or permission safety.
routing_and_status.frontend_requirements: Typed helper should retain HTTP status/error classification for this record read without changing every backend caller. 401 must still call redirect('/login'). 403 must show denied without alternate source/list read. 404 says record is absent from current report, not deleted/no history. 503 says unavailable and must not look empty/all-clear. Error rendering must not include returned source facts or try another endpoint.
routing_and_status.opaque_route: Construct a URL with encodeURIComponent(whole item_id) for one route segment and verify via a real request/click that slash-containing IDs round-trip to the correct record. Do not parse IDs by underscore or prefix; include cross-kind/unknown checks so IDs cannot resolve via another kind. Exact URL shape deferred to API contract.

actual_next_e2e_strategy.test_harness: Add an app-level Playwright project/test with baseURL pointing at actual Next dev/server, not Storybook. Existing config only sets Storybook baseURL and has no app webServer (apps/web/frontend/playwright.config.js). Start disposable HLA API/reporting fixture plus Next server; route the browser from the real operating-picture list to the Next dynamic detail page, whose server-side typed helper performs the API call. Seed distinct same-kind rows and records for all four kinds in the authorized source publications; assert clicked destination and rendered exact returned facts/component rows.
actual_next_e2e_strategy.url_encoding: For an actual opaque ID containing '/', inspect the rendered anchor href and click it; assert same route's server-resolved ID/result corresponds to exact API record. Also direct-load that href to cover deep links. If Next 14 dynamic-segment handling cannot deliver encoded slash, document proven limitation and choose a route encoding that preserves opaque whole key after API contract review; do not downgrade to type-section link.
actual_next_e2e_strategy.status_matrix: Against actual API contract/auth: signed-out 401 -> Next login redirect; reader lacking source capability 403 -> denied page with no source detail; unknown same-kind and cross-kind ID 404 -> current-report not-found language; unavailable source 503 -> unavailable state, never all-clear. Verify no alternate list/source endpoint is called for denial and failures expose no row fields.
actual_next_e2e_strategy.other: Keep Storybook for visual/presentational scenario coverage, not route proof. Deterministic test date via Playwright clock/frozen app time for days remaining. Do not update screenshot baselines just to silence host mismatches.
